translationRepairs: Zhang Lingzhao, chief inspector of the Pingsheng command, expelled Yanhao with the troops stationed under him, and Yanhao fled to Xiangzhou.
Zhang Lingzhao, chief inspector of the Pengsheng command, expelled Yanhao with the troops stationed under him, and Yanhao fled to Xiangzhou.
Focus unit titles Zhang Lingzhao 捧聖都虞候; 捧 is péng, so the unit name is Pengsheng, not Pingsheng. The proposed replacement corrects that romanization without changing the rest of the sentence.
Zhang Lingzhao, chief inspector of the Pingsheng command, drove Yanhao out with the garrison troops under his command, and Yanhao fled to Xiangzhou.
Zhang Lingzhao, chief inspector of the Pengsheng command, drove Yanhao out with the garrison troops under his command, and Yanhao fled to Xiangzhou.
The literal field has the same mistranscription of 捧聖 as Pingsheng; Pengsheng matches the Chinese and leaves the rest of the rendering intact.
